question: Which reference image does the harness comparison use (cover with text overlays, or the frames)?
probes: rebuild_check will show which comparisons run and what differs
resolution: The harness's app-screenshot check compares the rebuilt program's picture against the original's (inputs/ cover and frames). For this project it cannot run: this harness version (0.6.1) only supports Rust console, Rust+egui, Godot, Unity and Unreal stacks (no browser stack — verified from the craft-anything-cli binary), and craft.json was created with the default 'Rust + egui (eframe)' stack, so the check reports 'no built program to start' for a static browser demo. The request's own Playwright screenshot verification stands in for it.
